statement: Design the bounded resumable execution/sharding plan for whichever exact compressed FULL178 search representation becomes load-bearing, with explicit storage/runtime gates and no blind scale-out.

scope.field_or_model: GitHub Actions / local exact production runner and retained certificates
scope.quantifiers: all dispatched work units under the chosen compressed representation
scope.required_output: deterministic work-unit key, checkpoint/ingest contract, bounded shard plan, storage preflight, and cheap authorization gate design

queries: N104 178 rows 64111 strata canonical rank coverage
actions storage/evidence safety authorization + storage + compaction
matches: Existing resumable_prefix_engine.py and run_full178_resumable_work_unit.py are named by the retained production state; real Stage32 resume equivalence is recorded PASS.
Generation 36-38 retained exact FIFO checkpoint/frontier evidence, but prefix_indexed_compression supersedes the 52-unit Gen38 frontier as the enumeration mechanism.
N104 fixes the authoritative outer domain as 178 rows / 64111 exact (row_id,e) strata and the inner domain as half-open canonical indexed-terminal rank intervals per stratum.
Repository policy requires commit-range run-key authorization, 500 MB storage preflight, verify-before-compaction, compact retained certificates, and fail-closed resource stops.

attempts.blocker: CompressedTerminalIndexer(e,d) ranks are local to one exact (d,e) stratum, but the retained N106 contract used one global [0,total_terminal_count) rank domain and work-unit identity omitted row_id/d/e or an equivalent immutable stratum identity.

attempts.result: Replace the invalid single global rank domain by exact local rank domains for every manifest stratum; bind row_id,d,e and local stratum_terminal_count into every work-unit/checkpoint/ledger identity; aggregate exact cover within each stratum and then require exact coverage of all 64111 manifest strata.

representation_lock.forbidden_global_rank_domain: Do not interpret [0,688101306360803751427719294) as a canonical CompressedTerminalIndexer rank domain.

manifest_and_stratum_lock.stratum_terminal_count_rule: must be obtained/replayed from the exact source-locked indexed-terminal representation for the same (d,e); no total-domain offset is inferred

n104_reconciliation.outer_domain: exactly the 64111 manifest (row_id,e) strata over 178 residual rows
n104_reconciliation.inner_domain: half-open canonical indexed-terminal rank intervals local to each (row_id,e) stratum
n104_reconciliation.completion_rule: every expected manifest stratum appears exactly once at aggregate level and its local rank domain is covered exactly once with no gap, overlap, extra, unknown, source-lock mismatch, or conflicting duplicate
n104_reconciliation.global_consistency_rule: after all 64111 local strata are exactly covered, sum of all replayed stratum_terminal_count values must equal 688101306360803751427719294; this is a checksum/consistency condition, not a global rank coordinate

work_unit_contract.primary_partition: for one canonical stratum (row_id,d,e), disjoint half-open local rank intervals [rank_lo,rank_hi)
partition_invariants: row_id parses to the same d carried by the work unit
e is admissible for the exact manifest row
stratum_terminal_count matches exact replay of CompressedTerminalIndexer(e,d) under the locked representation
all intervals combined for a stratum share identical row_id,d,e,stratum_terminal_count and source locks
sorted accepted intervals inside one stratum are pairwise disjoint
complete stratum coverage requires first rank_lo=0, adjacent previous.rank_hi=next.rank_lo, and final rank_hi=stratum_terminal_count
interval boundaries are immutable within a generation
a changed representation/source/leaf/manifest contract creates a new generation rather than mutating prior work units
work_unit_contract.shard_sizing: runtime- and storage-bounded only after representative measurement; no fixed giant shard count is authorized by this plan

checkpoint_resume_contract.resume_rule: resume only at next_rank after verifying identical immutable stratum/source locks and verified local prefix [rank_lo,next_rank); never infer progress from runner time or artifact presence
checkpoint_resume_contract.completion_rule: COMPLETE only when verified_prefix=[rank_lo,rank_hi), processed_count=rank_hi-rank_lo, unknown_count=0, resource_wall_count=0, and compact certificate validation passes
checkpoint_resume_contract.failure_rule: UNKNOWN, source drift, manifest/stratum identity mismatch, authorization failure, quota/storage wall, malformed checkpoint, local rank gap/overlap, or conflicting duplicate remains non-credit and cannot be promoted to COMPLETE
checkpoint_resume_contract.idempotency: re-ingesting an identical work_unit_id + certificate digest is a no-op; a different digest for the same completed work_unit_id is a hard conflict

run_state_ledger_schema.per_stratum_acceptance: all planned work_unit_ids for the same canonical stratum are accounted for exactly once; accepted local intervals form [0,stratum_terminal_count); no conflicting duplicate; every COMPLETE certificate source-locks to the same generation/manifest/stratum
run_state_ledger_schema.global_aggregate_acceptance: the accepted stratum set equals the exact 64111-stratum manifest set with no missing or extra stratum; every stratum passes per_stratum_acceptance; every accepted disposition is exact and replayable; the sum of exact stratum_terminal_count values equals the canonical global terminal-count consistency value

authorization_gate.policy: fresh commit-range semantic run-key authorization before every heavy dispatch
authorization_gate.synchronize: require dedicated key path in verified github.event.before..pull_request.head.sha diff and strict generation/revision advance with locked parameters valid
authorization_gate.opened: cold preferred; if allowed, key must be newly introduced/changed relative to base and semantically armed
authorization_gate.reopened: cold; requires later synchronize with fresh generation/revision

preflight_required: largest plausible artifact per work unit
representative measured artifact size if no comparable prior run
storage_and_wave_gate.persistence_pattern: exact raw local compute -> full local verification -> deterministic compact certificate -> upload compact certificate -> aggregate -> final manifest
storage_and_wave_gate.raw_artifact_rule: if raw persistence is unavoidable, use bounded waves; compact and clean each wave before the next
storage_and_wave_gate.wave_size_rule: derive from measured artifact size and remaining 500 MB headroom; no convenience-based fixed wave size
stop_if: projected peak storage approaches/exhausts operating budget
failed/cancelled run leaves large non-credit intermediates requiring cleanup
evidence topology requires more simultaneous raw artifacts than planned
heavy run lacks fresh valid commit-range authorization

retry_rules: retry a failed work unit only from a validated checkpoint with identical manifest/stratum/representation/source/leaf locks

do not change interval boundaries inside a generation to rescue a hard shard; split only by creating an explicit child-partition manifest whose exact local union equals the blocked parent and whose parent is no longer independently creditable
a parameter/source/contract/manifest change starts a new generation
resource-wall results remain operational evidence only and grant no mathematical credit
before retry, remove unnecessary non-credit artifacts after preserving required compact commitments

required_adapters_after_leaf_contract_st: stratum-local rank-range dispatcher using exact unrank/inverse-rank representation
64111-stratum global completeness aggregator consistent with N104

notes: Mission startup does not authorize heavy compute.
The hostile-audit FAIL at review 5153281341 is retained and not erased by this repair.
The exact indexed rank coordinate is stratum-local under CompressedTerminalIndexer(e,d); the 27-digit total is only a cross-stratum consistency check.
N104 completeness architecture is now an explicit load-bearing dependency of this repaired contract.
No fixed shard count, heavy concurrency, or run-key path is invented here because those require an authorized implementation and measured preflight.
